_comment: Reference values for qe-relax-co (QE 7.4 conda-forge build hac89879_0, PBE, CO in 20-bohr box, ecutwfc=50 Ry / ecutrho=400 Ry, Gamma-only, mv smearing 0.01, BFGS relax). Calibrated on x86_64.
_calibration_note: QE 7.4 from conda-forge (channel carries no 7.3.1; 7.4 is the closest 7.x release), PSlibrary 1.0.0 kjpaw UPFs for C/O, 1 MPI rank + OMP_NUM_THREADS=2. 5 oracle runs produced identical values (energy spread 0 at 1e-8 Ry, bond spread 0, 5 BFGS steps every run, ~2 min per run). Bond tolerance per spec ±0.01 Å; energy at physical minimum resolution 1e-5 Ry. Cross-verify (L4): verifier reruns an SCF single point on the agent's final geometry; deterministic to ~1e-8, tol 1e-6.
